summary: Düsseldorf's parking policy since 2019 has combined plans for higher on-street prices and more resident-parking zones with a 2021 settlement on air quality that ruled out driving bans and listed park-and-ride and EV-charging expansion among its measures. Operators in the city centre have been adding ticketless entry, number-plate recognition and EV charging in garages, and two department stores in the centre stayed open after the 2024 Galeria insolvency.

items.text: The city administration proposed raising on-street parking in the inner-city zone from 2.90 to 4.00 euros per hour (Mon-Sat, 9:00-22:00), with a 5-euro flat rate overnight; the last change had been in December 2015. A council decision was pencilled in for 6 February 2020; the source does not report the outcome.
items.source_title: Düsseldorf: Konsequent gegen Autoverkehr – Parkgebühren sollen steigen

items.text: A June 2020 resolution extended resident parking in Düsseldorf from 31 to 56 zones, as part of the Mobility Plan D adopted in 2019.
items.source_title: Parkraumbewirtschaftung in 13 Bezirken, zunächst in Bilk und Flingern

items.text: APCOA took over operation of the underground car park at KII / Schauspielhaus (660 spaces on five levels) and introduced barcode plus number-plate recognition, dynamic pricing based on occupancy, an RFID chip for contactless barrier access, and 24 E.ON charging points.
items.source_title: Scheidt & Bachmann and APCOA Modernize Parking at KII in Düsseldorf

items.text: Q-Park took over the garage at Liesegangstraße previously run by Galeria Karstadt Kaufhof and renamed it Stadtmitte (519 spaces on six levels). It was to offer online reservation and number-plate recognition, with hourly price 2.50 euros; the report notes there were no EV charging points at that time and says Q-Park ran 12 facilities in Düsseldorf.
items.source_title: Düsseldorf: Karstadt-Parkhaus wurde von Q-Park übernommen

items.text: The State of North Rhine-Westphalia, the City of Düsseldorf and Deutsche Umwelthilfe settled the air-quality lawsuit; the state said there would be no driving bans. The agreed package includes traffic-signal control and Tempo 30 on key streets, more park-and-ride, more EV charging stations, and a new U81 line linking the main station, fairgrounds and airport.
items.source_title: Land Nordrhein-Westfalen, Stadt Düsseldorf und DUH schließen Vergleich zur Luftreinhalteplanung Düsseldorf

items.text: Mayor Stephan Keller suspended a planned rise in the resident parking permit fee, then 25 euros per year, citing rising household energy costs; the CDU backed this while coalition partner the Greens opposed it.
items.source_title: Düsseldorf: Knatsch bei Schwarz-Grün über die Aussetzung der Gebührenerhöhung für Anwohnerparken

items.text: CDU and Greens presented a plan to raise resident parking permits from 25 euros to 360 euros (zone 1), 300 euros (zone 2) and 240 euros (zone 3) per year, with implementation expected by the end of 2023. A taxpayers' association article from September 2023 says that after a federal court ruling of 13 June 2023 against tiered fees (in a Freiburg case), the city said it would pursue a socially compatible fee; the final fee is not established by these sources.
items.source_title: Düsseldorf plant deutliche Verteuerung des Anwohnerparkens

items.text: E.ON and Contipark announced more than 4,000 AC charge points (up to 22 kW) for Contipark garages in Germany and Austria over 2023-2025. The first Düsseldorf charge point was expected in February 2023; Contipark runs six garages in Düsseldorf, with about 30 charge points planned per site on average.
items.source_title: E.ON baut über 4.000 AC-Ladepunkte bei Contipark

items.text: A new charging park with more than 60 charge points opened on the roof of the IDR-run Carlsplatz garage, as part of a renovation the report prices at 900,000 euros that also added four XXL accessible spaces.
items.source_title: Düsseldorf Carlstadt: Nun strahlt der Carlsplatz wieder

items.text: APCOA leased an underground multi-storey car park at the Medical Center Düsseldorf (about 300 spaces, 130 already sold as permanent spaces), bringing its Düsseldorf locations to ten. The garage has ticketless entry and exit and cashless payment.
items.source_title: New Location in Düsseldorf: APCOA Leases Multi-Storey Car Park at the Medical Center

items.text: After Galeria's insolvency proceedings opened on 1 April 2024, both Düsseldorf stores (Kaufhof Kö and Schadowstraße) were to stay open and the company headquarters was to move from Essen to the Schadowstraße store; 16 other stores nationally were closing.
items.source_title: Düsseldorf geht als Gewinnerin aus der Galeria-Insolvenz hervor

items.text: APCOA reported 307 new charge points in operation across Germany in 2025; in Düsseldorf, 9 charge points went live in total at two sites, the Medical Center and DJC Nikko.
items.source_title: APCOA nimmt 2025 bundesweit 307 neue Ladepunkte in Betrieb
